contextRequirements.statement: A manual duration input is constrained to a range from 0:01 to 24:00.

Today's entries show in a list, each with its duration, and the day's total appears beneath the list equal to the sum of the entries' durations. When today has no entries, the list says 'No time tracked today.' and the total reads 0:00.
The page outputs a running timer display, an undo offer after a delete, and an error message when an action fails.
A person can pick a project for an entry from the short list of Admin, Client work or Internal, and the entry shows the chosen project.

When the page loads and no further action is taken, one egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' appear together as the page header, centered, keeping the egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' from the egg page as a centered header.
When the egg page loads and no further action is taken, the word 'Eggs' appears below the egg emoji in sans-serif text, with no inputs and no state mutations.
When the egg page loads and no further action is taken, a single egg emoji appears centered on the page, with no inputs and no state mutations.
A person can add an entry by hand with a duration, and the entry appears in today's list with that duration.

When today's list is empty and a person types what they are working on and starts the timer, Admin is chosen first for the entry, the entry shows the typed work, and the entry appears with a running timer.
Each end-to-end test takes a screenshot of its outcome.
A person can edit an entry's work and duration, and the entry shows the escaped edited work and duration.

A person can delete an entry, which removes it from today's list, and an undo appears that is announced to screen readers and reachable by keyboard. When the person chooses undo, the entry reappears in today's list.

specificationIntents.purpose:
# Feature

A page shows one egg emoji in the middle. Below it, the word 'Eggs' appears in sans-serif text.

# Intention & objectives

The page lets a visitor see an egg emoji centered on the screen. The word 'Eggs' sits under it in a plain sans-serif typeface.

# Feature

One page tracks time today. A person types what they are working on, picks a project from a short list, starts a timer and stops it. Today's entries show in a list with each duration and the day's total. A person can add an entry by hand with a duration, edit an entry, and delete one with an undo. Entries stay after a reload. The page keeps the egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' from the egg page as a centered header.

# Intention & objectives

A person who bills by the hour records where their day goes while they work, so the hours are right when they bill or report them later. This first slice proves the core loop for one day: start, stop, correct and total. Projects, clients, weeks and reports come in later slices.
